items.title: Jackie McLean — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: speaking to Jimmy Briggs, my stepfather

ctx.x: He got a little bit too friendly.

Yeah. He stopped, looked at my – my stepfather was shaving in the mirror. He stopped by the bathroom door and said, “Oh man.” He said, “Look at that physique. How you doing?”, speaking to Jimmy Briggs, my stepfather. I would take him up there. Then we would maybe go to the show, go to 42nd Street and go see a flick. And just hang out, get something to eat.
You brought a number of other musicians to him that really figured prominently, like Paul Chambers. Can you recount that?
